info.name: Live Transcription in Talk
info.summary: Provides live transcriptions in Nextcloud Talk calls.
info.description:
Provides live transcriptions in Nextcloud Talk calls. High-performance backend (HPB) is required for this app to work.
The installation steps can be found here: https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/ai/app_live_transcription.html#installation
IMPORTANT: Environment variables "LT_HPB_URL" and "LT_INTERNAL_SECRET" are required to be set in "Deploy Options" near the "Deploy and Enable" button before the install.
info.author: Anupam Kumar
Marcel Klehr

variable.name: LT_HPB_URL
variable.description: URL of the high-performance backend, same as the URL in the admin settings of Talk. It ends in "/spreed" usually and looks something like "wss://cloud.example.com/standalone-signaling/spreed".

variable.name: LT_INTERNAL_SECRET
variable.display-name: Internal secret of the high-performance backend
variable.description: Internal secret used to authenticate with the high-performance backend. This is the internal secret from the HPB and not the shared secret entered on the Nextcloud Server in the admin settings of Talk. It is set as "internalsecret = ..." in the server.conf file of the Talk Signaling HPB.

variable.name: LT_ASR_SERVER_URL
variable.display-name: URL of the speech recognition server (optional)
variable.description: Leave it empty to use the built-in transcriber. The app sends audio to this server for transcription. It must have the form "ws://localhost:2702". If the internal speech recognition server is enabled, it listens on this interface and port.

variable.name: LT_DISABLE_INTERNAL_ASR
variable.display-name: Disable the internal speech recognition server (optional)
variable.description: In this case "LT_ASR_SERVER_URL" must point at a working speech recognition server. That server must speak the websocket protocol documented in the readme. Accepted values are "1", "0", "true" and "false".

variable.name: SKIP_CERT_VERIFY
variable.description: When set to "true" or "1", certificate verifications will ke skipped for the websocket connections to the HPB.

variable.name: LT_MAX_WORKERS
variable.description: This bounds how many audio chunks are decoded at the same time, and by extension the maximum GPU and system memory usage. Participants above this number wait in a queue rather than being refused, thus a value above the CPU core count makes every speaker slower instead of adding capacity. The default is the CPU core count of the server.

variable.name: LT_ASR_THREADS
variable.description: This sets how many CPU threads one worker uses to decode a single audio chunk. The default is 1, which is the fastest setting as well as the cheapest, because a chunk is too small to divide across cores profitably. Raising it multiplies with "Max concurrent transcription workers" and makes every speaker slower, so leave it alone unless a measurement on your own hardware says otherwise.

variable.name: LT_ASR_DISABLE_VAD
variable.description: Voice activity detection keeps silent participants off the decoder. With it disabled a silent participant costs nearly as much CPU time as a speaking one, which puts a four-person call beyond realtime on a four-core host. Accepted values are "1", "0", "true" and "false".
